hero.subtitle: AIOps for data centers and critical facilities: predictive AI on power, cooling and facility telemetry, linked to work orders.

challenge.title: Why it works
challenge.body: Power chain and cooling cause most data center outages, and both show degradation days to weeks before failure. The data already sits in the BMS; we act on it.
points: Power chain: 40–55% of data center outages
Degradation shows days to weeks before failure
The data already sits in the BMS

opportunity.title: The biggest causes of downtime are also the most predictable
opportunity.body: Predictive DC Operations unifies IT and OT telemetry with predictive AI and maintenance workflows. We detect degradation around a week before a threshold alarm, then raise the SLA-bound work order and dispatch the vendor and parts, with a human approving critical actions.

capabilities.title: Real-time OT analytics
capabilities.body: Vibration, thermal, harmonics, power and environmental telemetry.

capabilities.title: Predictive AI engine
capabilities.body: Anomaly detection, remaining-life insight and criticality scoring.

capabilities.title: CMMS / CAFM workflows
capabilities.body: SLA-bound work orders, with vendor and parts dispatch.

capabilities.title: Governed closure
capabilities.body: Human approval, evidence, audit trail and compliance mapping.

capabilities.title: Private LLM copilots
capabilities.body: Copilots on private LLMs, with zero data egress.

applications.title: Power chain
applications.body: Predictive AI on power telemetry, where 40–55% of outages originate.

applications.title: Cooling
applications.body: Early detection of degradation in cooling, the source of 15–25% of outages.

applications.title: Data center operators
applications.body: A subscription per site, MW or asset count, starting with a POC on existing BMS telemetry.

applications.title: Critical facilities
applications.body: The same AIOps on power, cooling and facility telemetry for critical facilities.

applications.title: Sovereign AI factories
applications.body: Intelligent operations is a layer of our AI factory architecture: DCIM, AIOps and a single pane of glass.

vision2030.body: Closure is governed: human approval, evidence, an audit trail and compliance mapping on every work order, with the data kept in-Kingdom.

deployment.note: Runs on the telemetry that already sits in your BMS, with private LLM copilots and zero data egress.
